cobblemon.ability.steamengine.desc: Grants immunity to Water-type moves. Being hit by a Fire- or Water-type move drastically raises the Pokemon's Speed.
cobblemon.ability.plus.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's Attack and Sp. Atk by 50% when an ally with Plus or Minus is on the field.
cobblemon.ability.minus.desc: Boosts the Pokemon's Attack and Sp. Atk by 50% when an ally with Plus or Minus is on the field.
